text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: While training outside with T.M. Opera O—

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Um... you're T.M. Opera O-san, right?
I'm a huge fan of yours!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Oho!
You seem to have quite the discerning eye!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
For someone like you, I have a special photo print
that was just freshly taken the other day—

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
It's gone!
Where did my special bromide photo go?!
choice_data_list: Weren't they handing out a ton of them earlier?
Weren't they handing out a ton of them earlier?

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
D-Drat!
Did I hand them all out back then?!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
"...Forgive me, my friend.
Please let me off with just an autograph this time."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
In stark contrast to the fan rejoicing over the autograph,
TM Opera O became thoroughly dejected.
